description: Link an action to a trigger so the trigger's events invoke it (POST /ncf/api/v2/triggers/{name}/link-action). Fails with 80901 DUPLICATED_RULE if already linked, 80324/80519 when a link limit is exceeded.

actionName.description: Action name. '{packageName}/{actionName}' is also accepted and split automatically.

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

name: ncloud_functions_link_trigger_action
